subject: Systemic lupus erythematosus (lupus)
object: a long-term condition causing joint pain, skin rashes and tiredness.
source_quote: Lupus (systemic lupus erythematosus) is a long-term condition that causes joint pain, skin rashes and tiredness.

subject: Lupus
object: an autoimmune condition, which means the immune system (the body's natural defence system) attacks healthy parts of the body.
source_quote: Lupus is an autoimmune condition. This means the body's natural defence system (immune system) attacks healthy parts of your body.

subject: Lupus
object: contagious.
source_quote: It's not contagious.

subject: The causes of lupus
object: possible causes include viral infection, certain medicines, sunlight, puberty, childbirth and menopause.
source_quote: The causes of lupus are not fully understood. Possible causes include: viral infection certain medicines sunlight puberty childbirth menopause

subject: Lupus
object: more women than men, and is more common in women with an African, Caribbean, Asian or Chinese background.
source_quote: More women than men get lupus, and it's more common in women with an African, Caribbean, Asian or Chinese background.

subject: The main symptoms of lupus
object: joint and muscle pain; extreme tiredness that will not go away however much the person rests; and rashes that usually come on after being in the sun, often over the nose and cheeks.
source_quote: The main symptoms include: joint and muscle pain extreme tiredness that will not go away no matter how much you rest rashes that usually come on after being in the sun – the rash is often over the nose and cheeks

subject: A person with lupus
object: headaches; mouth ulcers; a high temperature; hair loss; weight loss; swollen glands, usually in the neck, armpits or groin; depression and anxiety; chest or tummy pain; or Raynaud's (changes in the colour of the fingers and toes when cold, anxious or stressed).
source_quote: You might also have: headaches mouth ulcers a high temperature hair loss weight loss swollen glands, usually in the neck, armpits or groin depression and anxiety chest or tummy pain changes in the colour of your fingers and toes when you're cold, anxious or stressed (Raynaud's)

subject: Lupus
object: with symptoms becoming worse for a few weeks, sometimes longer, and then settling down (remission); the reason why symptoms flare up or settle down is not known.
source_quote: Lupus often flares up (relapses) and symptoms become worse for a few weeks, sometimes longer. Symptoms then settle down (remission). The reason why symptoms flare up or settle down is not known.

subject: Some people with lupus
object: any difference between flare-ups and remission, and their symptoms are constant.
source_quote: Lupus often flares up (relapses) and symptoms become worse for a few weeks, sometimes longer. Symptoms then settle down (remission). The reason why symptoms flare up or settle down is not known. Some people do not notice any difference and their symptoms are constant.

subject: Lupus
relation: can be mild, moderate or severe:
object: mild lupus causes joint and skin problems and tiredness; moderate lupus causes inflammation of other parts of the skin and body, including the lungs, heart and kidneys; severe lupus causes inflammation with severe damage to the heart, lungs, brain or kidneys, which can be life-threatening.
source_quote: Severity | How it affects the body Mild | Joint and skin problems, tiredness Moderate | Inflammation of other parts of the skin and body, including your lungs, heart and kidneys Severe | Inflammation causing severe damage to the heart, lungs, brain or kidneys, which can be life- threatening

subject: Lupus
relation: is not always easy to diagnose,
object: because its symptoms can be similar to those of other conditions.
source_quote: Lupus is not always easy to diagnose because the symptoms can be similar to other conditions.

subject: A GP assessing a person for lupus
object: some blood tests, and may diagnose lupus if the tests show high levels of a certain type of antibody and the person also has the typical symptoms of lupus.
source_quote: Lupus is not always easy to diagnose because the symptoms can be similar to other conditions. A GP will usually do some blood tests. They may diagnose lupus if the tests show you have high levels of a certain type of antibody, and you also have the typical symptoms of lupus.

subject: A person being assessed for lupus
object: X-rays and scans of the heart, kidneys and other organs if the doctor thinks they might be affected.
source_quote: You might be referred for X-rays and scans of your heart, kidneys and other organs if the doctor thinks they might be affected.

subject: A person with confirmed lupus
object: regular checks and tests, such as blood tests to check for anaemia and urine tests to check for kidney problems.
source_quote: If lupus is confirmed, you'll be advised to have regular checks and tests, such as blood tests to check for anaemia and urine tests to check for kidney problems.

subject: Treatment for lupus
object: anti-inflammatory medicines like ibuprofen; hydroxychloroquine for fatigue and skin and joint problems; and steroid tablets, injections and creams for kidney inflammation and rashes.
source_quote: Treatment you may have for lupus includes: anti-inflammatory medicines like ibuprofen hydroxychloroquine for fatigue and skin and joint problems steroid tablets, injections and creams for kidney inflammation and rashes

subject: Immunosuppressant or biological medicines
object: severe lupus; they help to calm or control the body's immune system.
source_quote: Immunosuppressant or biological medicines are sometimes used to treat severe lupus. They help to calm or control your body's immune system.

subject: A person with lupus
object: smoke: smoking makes lupus worse, so it is important to stop.
source_quote: do not smoke – smoking makes lupus worse so it's important to stop smoking

subject: A person with lupus
object: sit in direct sunlight or spend a lot of time in rooms with fluorescent lights.
source_quote: do not sit in direct sunlight or spend a lot of time in rooms with fluorescent lights

subject: Lupus
object: no cure, but symptoms can improve if treatment starts early, and lupus is better managed if it is found and treated early.
source_quote: There's no cure, but symptoms can improve if treatment starts early. Lupus is better managed if it's found and treated early.

subject: Lupus
object: complications in pregnancy; a person with lupus should see a doctor before trying to get pregnant, who can discuss the risks and check whether their medicine needs to be changed.
source_quote: Lupus can cause complications in pregnancy. See a doctor before trying to get pregnant. They can discuss the risks and check if your medicine needs to be changed.
